photos.file: 65.016 BF1659 Yellow Horned, Achlya flavicornis, eggs on Birch (3387313178).jpg
photos.desc: While moth trapping I found a pair of Yellow Horned Moths mating in the trap and so retained the female until she laid eggs. I shall attempt to rear these and photograph the larvae.
